title: Portable mini-golf / cornhole course rentals
one_liner: Event rentals: portable mini-golf or cornhole packages sold via local social/FBMP; agent runs booking ops, Brandon owns gear and delivery gates.
why_agent_runnable: Pricing research, booking site/forms, outreach drafts, and calendar ops are agent-native. Brandon buys gear, delivers/sets up (or hires), and approves spend/publish.

ops_steps.title: Package + geo demand
ops_steps.detail: Comps for party rentals, weekend density, corporate event calendars in target geo.

ops_steps.title: Brandon package pick
ops_steps.detail: Choose mini-golf vs cornhole (or both), CapEx ceiling, storage plan.

ops_steps.title: Gear BOM + CapEx memo
ops_steps.detail: Bill of materials, vendors, trailer needs; Brandon money gate before purchase.

ops_steps.title: Booking funnel drafts
ops_steps.detail: Landing, packages, FAQ, contract template, FB/IG creative drafts.

ops_steps.title: Publish + calendar
ops_steps.detail: Approve site/listings go-live; payments account; insurance check if needed.

ops_steps.title: Outbound to venues
ops_steps.detail: Draft venue/HOA/corporate outreach — Brandon send gate.

ops_steps.title: Fulfillment SOP
ops_steps.detail: Load-in/out checklist, damage deposit flow, review asks; hire delivery help only with Brandon gate.

human_only_checkpoints: Any purchase, deposit, ad spend, or paid tool upgrade
Hiring contractors, VAs, or licensed trades
Publishing listings, sites, ads, social as official
Physical pickup, delivery, install, or on-site work

hiring_and_pay_flow.how_agent_initiates: Agent drafts Upwork/OnlineJobs/Craigslist job posts, contractor shortlists, SOWs, and payment memos in plan drafts only.
brandon_gates_before_money: approve recurring retainer or inventory buy

unit_economics_sketch.capex_range_usd: 800-8000 depending on DIY vs pro course kits
unit_economics_sketch.utilization_notes: Weekends and holidays drive utilization; off-season is the risk.
unit_economics_sketch.gross_margin_notes: After CapEx amortized, main costs are transport, labor, storage, damage. Ranges are sketches only — not guarantees.
unit_economics_sketch.disclaimer: No income guarantees. Creator anecdotes ≠ your results.

first_7_day_agent_sprint: Day 1-2: demand comps + weekend calendar scan
kill_criteria: Cannot hit CapEx ceiling with usable kit
Fewer than 2 paid bookings in first 45 days after go-live at agreed marketing effort
Damage/storage costs exceed agreed monthly burn
disclaimer: Research plan only. Not financial, legal, or investment advice. No income guarantees. Brandon approval required before money, hire, pay, publish, or send.
